text: A prince ought to take care never to make an alliance with one more powerful than himself for the purposes of attacking others, unless necessity compels him, as is said above; because if he conquers you are at his discretion, and princes ought to avoid as much as possible being at the discretion of any one.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XXI, How a prince should conduct himself so as to gain renown
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
